STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_168547.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_168547.v · Open raw
module origen_168547 (
    input           clk,
    input           rst_n,
    input           start,
    input           tf_empty,
    input [NUM_PARSER-1:0] ps_finish,
    input           page_input_finish,
    input [NUM_PARSER-1:0] ps_empty,
    input [15:0]    ram_empty,
    input           cl_finish,
    output          page_finish
);

parameter NUM_PARSER = 4;
localparam PARSER_ALLONE = {NUM_PARSER{1'b1}};

reg             all_empty;
reg             page_input_finish_flag;
reg [15:0]      all_empty_delay;
reg [2:0]       state;
reg             page_finish_r;
reg             block_finish_r;

always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (~rst_n) begin
        all_empty <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
        if (ps_empty == PARSER_ALLONE && ram_empty == 16'hffff && tf_empty) begin
            all_empty <= 1'b1;
        end else begin
            all_empty <= 1'b0;
        end
    end
end

always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (~rst_n) begin
        page_input_finish_flag <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
        if (start) begin
            page_input_finish_flag <= 1'b0;
        end else if (page_input_finish) begin
            page_input_finish_flag <= 1'b1;
        end
    end
end

always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (~rst_n) begin
        all_empty_delay <= 16'b0;
    end else begin
        all_empty_delay <= {all_empty_delay[14:0], all_empty};
    end
end

always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (~rst_n) begin
        state <= 3'd0;
        page_finish_r <= 1'b0;
        block_finish_r <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
        case (state)
            3'd0: begin
                page_finish_r <= 1'b0;
                block_finish_r <= 1'b0;
                if (~tf_empty) begin
                    state <= 3'd1;
                end
            end
            3'd1: begin
                page_finish_r <= 1'b0;
                block_finish_r <= 1'b0;
                if (page_input_finish && tf_empty) begin
                    state <= 3'd3;
                end
            end
            3'd3: begin
                if (all_empty_delay == 16'hffff && all_empty && tf_empty) begin
                    page_finish_r <= 1'b1;
                end
                if (cl_finish) begin
                    state <= 3'd4;
                end
            end
            3'd4: begin
                block_finish_r <= 1'b0;
                state <= 3'd0;
                page_finish_r <= 1'b0;
            end
            default: begin
                state <= 3'd0;
            end
        endcase
    end
end

assign page_finish = page_finish_r;

endmodule
